title: 국방정보본부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:16208:19990330:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 16208, March 30, 1999>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Repeal of Other Statutes and Regulations)
The Decree on the Armed Forces Intelligence Command and the Decree on the 777th Unit of the Ministry of National Defense shall each be repealed.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Regulations on Operational Units, etc. of Each Armed Service Whose Principal Mission Is Combat under Article 9 (3) of the Act on the Organization of National Armed Forces shall be amended as follows:
Subparagraph 1 of Article 3 shall be deleted.
(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Secret Protection Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1) 6, "Commander of the Armed Forces Intelligence Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Intelligence Command".
(3) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 13 (1) 2 (a), "Commander of the Special Intelligence Unit of the Ministry of National Defense and Commander of the Armed Forces Intelligence Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Intelligence Command and Commander of Unit 777".
In the column of Army positions in attached Table 1, "Commander of the Armed Forces Intelligence Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Intelligence Command", and "Commander of the Special Intelligence Unit of the Ministry of National Defense" shall be replaced with "Commander of Unit 777"; and "Deputy Head of the Defense Intelligence Headquarters" shall be deleted.
(4) Part of the Regulations on Delegation and Entrustment of Administrative Authority shall be amended as follows:
In Article 23 (3), "Commander of the Armed Forces Intelligence Command" shall be replaced with "Head of the Defense Intelligence Headquarters".
